**Figure S8.** Range-area contrasts involving obligate mutualists, and between
facultative and non-associated species, in the core analyses of Fig. 4: A,
mutualist/parasite; B, facultative/mutualist; C, non-associated/mutualist; D,
facultative/non-associated (range-area ratios on a common logarithmic axis, with
a reference line at one). Rows, groups, sample sizes and * are as in Fig. 4.
Bars are Tukey-adjusted 95% confidence intervals, and filled points indicate
p < 0.05.

**Table S12.** Interaction-type contrasts and partner-breadth effects for range
area, latitudinal extent and longitudinal extent, in the core analyses of Fig. 4
(first block, in the order and with the labels of Fig. 4) and in further checks
(second block: the taxonomic model with the regional butterfly background, PGLS
of tree-matched species only, PGLS with the butterfly background,
range-stability subsets and wingspan as a covariate). Ratios compare the first
category with the second, with Tukey-adjusted 95% confidence intervals and
p-values; breadth is the ratio per additional recorded ant genus, with a
coefficient-based interval and p-value. N: species/parasites in the type model,
with the species of the breadth model in brackets, or genus-by-type
units/parasitic units in genus-level PGLS. Range-stability subsets use the 90% criterion of @gupta2020 and looser (80%)
and stricter (95%) thresholds (Appendix S2); they are defined separately for
each range measure, so their samples differ. Breadth is not
given (–) for genus-level PGLS, which has no breadth model. Rarefied ranges use
ten random localities per species (Table S13b). P-values smaller than 0.05 are bold.

::: {.allow-page-break}
```{r table-s12-robustness}
options(report_table_width = 9) # Appendix S7 and Tables S12-S14 are on landscape pages
effects <- c(`f-p` = "f / p", `n-p` = "n / p", `m-p` = "m / p", `f-m` = "f / m", `n-m` = "n / m", `f-n` = "f / n",
             breadth = "Ant genus")
s3 <- robust[robust$contrast %in% names(effects), ]
# p-values on a second line in every cell: ten columns cannot hold "ratio (CI) p" on one line
s3$cell <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)%s%s", s3$ratio, s3$lower, s3$upper, report_line_break, format_table_p(s3$p))
# core analyses first, in the order of Figure 4, then the further specifications in report order
s12_order <- c(core_analyses, setdiff(names(analysis_labels), core_analyses))
stopifnot(all(core_analyses %in% names(analysis_labels)))
rows <- expand.grid(measure = c("area", "lat", "lon"), analysis = s12_order, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# short row labels, those of the core analyses as in Figure 4, so that the table fits a landscape page
s12_labels <- c(
  lmm = "Taxonomic LMM (main)", spherical_gam = "Spatial GAM",
  pgls_grafted_yumnam_2025 = "Species PGLS, Yumnam", pgls_grafted_schar_2018 = "Species PGLS, Schär",
  phylo_spatial_yumnam_2025 = "Joint GAM, Yumnam", phylo_spatial_schar_2018 = "Joint GAM, Schär",
  pgls_genus_yumnam_2025 = "Genus PGLS, Yumnam", pgls_genus_schar_2018 = "Genus PGLS, Schär",
  rarefied_k10 = "Rarefied ranges", modelled_ranges_daru = "Modelled ranges",
  background_500km_butterflies = "LMM + butterfly background",
  pgls_yumnam_2025 = "Matched PGLS, Yumnam", pgls_schar_2018 = "Matched PGLS, Schär",
  pgls_background_yumnam_2025 = "PGLS + background, Yumnam", pgls_background_schar_2018 = "PGLS + background, Schär",
  stability_80 = "Stability 80%", stability_90 = "Stability 90%", stability_95 = "Stability 95%",
  wingspan_covariate = "Wingspan covariate")
stopifnot(setequal(names(s12_labels), names(analysis_labels)))
s3_display <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(i) {
  x <- s3[s3$analysis == rows$analysis[i] & s3$measure == rows$measure[i], ]
  if (!nrow(x)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  n_type <- x$n[x$contrast == "f-p"]
  n_parasite <- x$n_parasite[x$contrast == "f-p"]
  stopifnot(length(n_type) == 1L, length(n_parasite) == 1L, is.finite(n_parasite))
  n_breadth <- x$n[x$contrast == "breadth"]
  n_cell <- sprintf("%s/%s", n_type, n_parasite)
  out <- data.frame(
    Analysis = if (rows$measure[i] == "area") unname(s12_labels[rows$analysis[i]]) else "",
    Metric = c(area = "Area", lat = "Lat", lon = "Lon")[[rows$measure[i]]],
    N = if (length(n_breadth)) sprintf("%s (%s)", n_cell, n_breadth) else n_cell, check.names = FALSE
  )
  for (e in names(effects)) {
    v <- x$cell[match(e, x$contrast)]
    out[[effects[[e]]]] <- if (is.na(v)) "–" else v
  }
  out$core <- rows$analysis[i] %in% core_analyses
  out
}))
stopifnot(all(s3_display$Metric[s3_display$Analysis != ""] == "Area"))
# group-heading rows instead of a 'Set' column
group_row <- function(label) {
  g <- s3_display[1, setdiff(names(s3_display), "core")]; g[] <- ""; g$Analysis <- label; g
}
s3_display <- rbind(group_row("**Core analyses (Fig. 4)**"), s3_display[s3_display$core, names(s3_display) != "core"],
                    group_row("**Further sensitivity analyses**"), s3_display[!s3_display$core, names(s3_display) != "core"])
report_table(s3_display, escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```
:::

**Table S13a.** Recorded partner breadth within interaction strategies, for all
three range measures. Ratios and coefficient-based 95% intervals are per
additional recorded ant genus. Facultative models contain a breadth slope with
taxonomic random effects, with or without a spherical spatial smooth; obligate
models contain type and breadth with taxonomic random effects. N is the number
of species. Singularity denotes a boundary variance estimate in a taxonomic
model (– for GAM). P-values smaller than 0.05 are bold.

```{r table-s13a-within-breadth}
w13 <- within_breadth
stopifnot(all(w13$model %in% c("lmm_facultative", "spherical_gam_facultative", "lmm_obligate")))
w13 <- w13[order(
  match(w13$model, c("lmm_facultative", "spherical_gam_facultative", "lmm_obligate")),
  match(w13$measure, c("area", "lat", "lon"))
), ]
report_table(data.frame(
  Model = c(
    lmm_facultative = "Facultative: taxonomic", spherical_gam_facultative = "Facultative: spatial",
    lmm_obligate = "Obligates: taxonomic, type adjusted"
  )[w13$model],
  Metric = c(area = "Area", lat = "Lat", lon = "Lon")[w13$measure], N = w13$n, Singular = ifelse(is.na(w13$singular), "–", ifelse(w13$singular, "Yes", "No")),
  `Ratio (95% CI), p` = cell_ci(w13), check.names = FALSE
), escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

**Table S13b.** Balanced-locality range-area models and their full-range
comparisons on exactly the same species. K10/K20: ten/twenty randomly sampled
cleaned localities; K10 cells: ten distinct occupied 25-km cells. N is the
type-model sample (breadth sample in brackets); P is the number of parasites in
the type model. Values are ratios with Tukey-adjusted 95% intervals and p-values
for type contrasts, and coefficient-based inference for breadth. Breadth is not
fitted in these spatial rarefaction models (–). All sampling treatments use 200
draws; uncertainty conditions on their geometric-mean range estimate. P-values smaller than 0.05 are bold.

::: {.allow-page-break}
```{r table-s13b-balanced}
review_effects <- c(`f-p` = "f / p", `n-p` = "n / p", `m-p` = "m / p", `f-m` = "f / m", breadth = "Ant genus")
q13 <- rare_results[rare_results$measure == "area", ]
q13$contrast <- gsub(" ", "", q13$contrast)
q13$cell <- cell_ci(q13)
qkeys <- unique(q13[c("model", "sampling", "ranges")])
qkeys <- qkeys[order(
  match(qkeys$model, c("lmm", "spherical_gam")),
  match(qkeys$sampling, c("k10", "k20", "k10_cells")),
  match(qkeys$ranges, c("rarefied", "full_same_species"))
), ]
qt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(qkeys)), function(i) {
  x <- q13[q13$model == qkeys$model[i] & q13$sampling == qkeys$sampling[i] & q13$ranges == qkeys$ranges[i], ]
  a <- x[x$contrast == "f-p", ]
  b <- x[x$contrast == "breadth", ]
  stopifnot(nrow(a) == 1L, nrow(b) <= 1L)
  out <- data.frame(
    Model = ifelse(qkeys$model[i] == "lmm", "Taxonomic", "Spatial"),
    Draw = c(k10 = "K10", k20 = "K20", k10_cell = "K10 cells", k10_cells = "K10 cells")[qkeys$sampling[i]],
    Range = ifelse(qkeys$ranges[i] == "rarefied", "Rarefied", "Full, same species"),
    N = if (nrow(b)) sprintf("%s (%s)", a$n, b$n) else as.character(a$n), P = a$n_parasite,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  for (e in names(review_effects)) {
    v <- x$cell[match(e, x$contrast)]
    out[[review_effects[[e]]]] <- ifelse(is.na(v), "–", v)
  }
  out
}))
report_table(qt, escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```
:::

**Table S13c.** Range-area contrasts testing the influence of sample, lineage
and region: the full-sample taxonomic model as reference; PGLS and the
taxonomic model on the same tree-matched species; omission of all species of
*Lepidochrysops* and *Thestor* (the taxonomic model, species-level PGLS on the
genus-grafted trees and genus-by-type PGLS, which weights each retained unit
equally); and species
centred within or outside southern Africa, or in Afro-Eurasia and Australasia
(definitions in Appendix S5). N/P: species/parasites, or genus-by-type
units/parasitic units. Values are ratios with Tukey-adjusted 95% intervals and
p-values. P-values smaller than 0.05 are bold.

::: {.allow-page-break}
```{r table-s13c-concentration}
region_effects <- review_effects[names(review_effects) != "breadth"]
r13 <- regional_results[regional_results$measure == "area", ]
r13$tree[is.na(r13$tree)] <- "none"
r13$contrast <- gsub(" ", "", r13$contrast)
r13$cell <- cell_ci(r13)
rkeys <- unique(r13[c("model", "subset", "dropped", "tree")])
stopifnot(all(rkeys$subset %in% c("all", "southern_Africa_only", "excluding_southern_Africa", "Old_World_only")))
rkeys <- rkeys[order(
  match(rkeys$subset, c("all", "southern_Africa_only", "excluding_southern_Africa", "Old_World_only")),
  rkeys$dropped != "none", match(rkeys$model, c("lmm", "pgls")), match(rkeys$tree, c("none", "yumnam_2025", "schar_2018"))
), ]
region_name <- c(
  all = "Global", southern_Africa_only = "Southern Africa only",
  excluding_southern_Africa = "Excluding southern Africa", Old_World_only = "Afro-Eurasia and Australasia"
)
tree_name <- c(yumnam_2025 = "Yumnam", schar_2018 = "Schär")
rt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(rkeys)), function(i) {
  x <- r13[r13$model == rkeys$model[i] & r13$subset == rkeys$subset[i] &
    r13$dropped == rkeys$dropped[i] & r13$tree == rkeys$tree[i], ]
  a <- x[x$contrast == "f-p", ]
  stopifnot(nrow(a) == 1L)
  out <- data.frame(
    Sample = ifelse(rkeys$dropped[i] == "none", region_name[rkeys$subset[i]],
      "Without Lepidochrysops + Thestor"
    ),
    Model = ifelse(rkeys$model[i] == "lmm", "Taxonomic", paste("PGLS", tree_name[rkeys$tree[i]])),
    `N / P` = sprintf("%s / %s", a$n, a$n_parasite), check.names = FALSE
  )
  for (e in names(region_effects)) out[[region_effects[[e]]]] <- x$cell[match(e, x$contrast)]
  out
}))
g13 <- pair_genus[pair_genus$measure == "area", ]
g13$cell <- cell_ci(g13)
gt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("yumnam_2025", "schar_2018"), function(s) {
  x <- g13[g13$tree == s, ]
  a <- x[x$contrast == "f-p", ]
  stopifnot(nrow(a) == 1L)
  out <- data.frame(
    Sample = "Without Lepidochrysops + Thestor", Model = paste("Genus-by-type PGLS", tree_name[s]),
    `N / P` = sprintf("%s / %s", a$n_units, a$n_p_units), check.names = FALSE
  )
  for (e in names(region_effects)) out[[region_effects[[e]]]] <- x$cell[match(e, x$contrast)]
  out
}))
mc <- matched_checks[matched_checks$measure == "area", ]
mc$contrast <- gsub(" ", "", mc$contrast)
mc$ratio <- mc$range_ratio
mc$lower <- mc$ratio_lower
mc$upper <- mc$ratio_upper
mc$p <- mc$p.value
mc$cell <- cell_ci(mc)
mm <- matched_checks_metadata[matched_checks_metadata$measure == "area" & matched_checks_metadata$predictors == "type", ]
mt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(mm)), function(i) {
  x <- mc[mc$model == mm$model[i] & mc$study == mm$study[i], ]
  stopifnot(sum(x$contrast == "f-p") == 1L)
  # Matched LMM metadata may not contain type counts; obtain them from PGLS's identical sample.
  p <- mm$n_parasite[mm$model == "pgls" & mm$study == mm$study[i]]
  out <- data.frame(
    Sample = paste("Matched", tree_name[mm$study[i]]),
    Model = ifelse(mm$model[i] == "pgls", "PGLS", "Taxonomic, same species"),
    `N / P` = sprintf("%s / %s", mm$n[i], p), check.names = FALSE
  )
  for (e in names(region_effects)) out[[region_effects[[e]]]] <- x$cell[match(e, x$contrast)]
  out
}))
# blocks: full-sample reference, matched species, lineage omission, regional subsets
reference <- rkeys$subset == "all" & rkeys$dropped == "none"
lineage <- rkeys$subset == "all" & rkeys$dropped != "none"
stopifnot(sum(reference) == 1L, sum(lineage) >= 1L)
block <- function(x, label) cbind(Test = c(label, rep("", nrow(x) - 1L)), x)
report_table(rbind(block(rt[reference, ], "Reference"), block(mt, "Matched species"),
                   block(rbind(rt[lineage, ], gt), "Lineage omission"),
                   block(rt[!reference & !lineage, ], "Region")), escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```
:::

**Table S13d.** Functional form of recorded partner breadth on the identical
sample, retaining interaction type and taxonomic random effects. AIC and delta
AIC compare maximum-likelihood fits within each response. For comparability,
effects and coefficient-based intervals from REML fits express a change from one
to two recorded ant genera: the raw-count coefficient directly, and the log1p
coefficient multiplied by log(3/2) before back-transformation. P-values test the
respective breadth coefficient. P-values smaller than 0.05 are bold.

```{r table-s13d-breadth-scale}
sc <- check_table("breadth_scale_comparison")
br <- check_table("breadth_raw_coefficients")
bl <- check_table("breadth_log1p_coefficients")
br$scale <- "raw"
bl$scale <- "log1p"
bc <- rbind(br, bl)
sc <- merge(sc, bc[c("measure", "scale", "range_ratio", "ratio_lower", "ratio_upper", "p_value")],
  by = c("measure", "scale")
)
sc <- sc[order(match(sc$measure, c("area", "lat", "lon")), match(sc$scale, c("raw", "log1p"))), ]
factor_change <- ifelse(sc$scale == "raw", 1, log(3 / 2))
sc$ratio <- sc$range_ratio^factor_change
sc$lower <- sc$ratio_lower^factor_change
sc$upper <- sc$ratio_upper^factor_change
sc$p <- sc$p_value
report_table(
  data.frame(
    Metric = c(area = "Area", lat = "Lat", lon = "Lon")[sc$measure],
    Scale = c(raw = "Raw count", log1p = "log(1 + count)")[sc$scale], N = sc$n,
    AIC = sprintf("%.2f", sc$AIC), `Delta AIC` = sprintf("%.2f", sc$delta_AIC),
    `Ratio, one to two genera (95% CI), p` = cell_ci(sc), check.names = FALSE
  ),
  escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)
```

**Table S14a.** Sensitivity of range-area results to occurrence cleaning, using
each treatment's eligible species and the identical species shared by all three
treatments. Interaction types, partner coding and taxonomic assignments are
fixed. N is the type-model sample (breadth sample in brackets). Values are
ratios with Tukey-adjusted 95% intervals and p-values for type contrasts, and
coefficient-based inference for breadth. Stringent is the manuscript's primary
treatment. Intermediate and inclusive treatments are defined in Appendix S2. P-values smaller than 0.05 are bold.

```{r table-s14a-cleaning}
c14 <- cleaning_results[cleaning_results$measure == "area" &
  ((cleaning_results$predictors == "type") | cleaning_results$contrast == "breadth"), ]
c14$cell <- cell_ci(c14)
ckeys <- expand.grid(
  cleaning = c("inclusive", "main", "strict_plus"),
  sample = c("eligible", "identical_species"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
ct <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(ckeys)), function(i) {
  x <- c14[c14$cleaning == ckeys$cleaning[i] & c14$sample == ckeys$sample[i], ]
  a <- x[x$contrast == "f-p", ]
  b <- x[x$contrast == "breadth", ]
  stopifnot(nrow(a) == 1L, nrow(b) == 1L)
  out <- data.frame(
    Sample = ifelse(ckeys$sample[i] == "eligible", "Eligible", "Identical species"),
    Cleaning = c(inclusive = "Inclusive", main = "Intermediate", strict_plus = "Stringent")[ckeys$cleaning[i]],
    N = sprintf("%s (%s)", a$n, b$n), check.names = FALSE
  )
  for (e in names(review_effects)) out[[review_effects[[e]]]] <- x$cell[match(e, x$contrast)]
  out
}))
report_table(ct, escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```
